lines.en: label ramen1:
scene firsttsuneyoramen0
I show up at a seedy ramen shop in the second half of town.
lines.zh: 我来到城镇另一半的一家破旧拉面店。

lines.en: A noodle-sanctuary in a land of shit.
lines.zh: 一片屎之地里的面条圣所。

lines.en: Or as Tsuneyo calls it, home.
lines.zh: 或者用 Tsuneyo 的话说，家。

lines.en: The walls are stone and stained with years worth of pork broth condensation, turning what I’m sure was a once-spotless restaurant into...
lines.zh: 墙是石砌的，被长年累月的猪骨汤蒸汽熏得斑斑驳驳，把这家我敢肯定曾经一尘不染的餐馆变成了……

lines.en: Well, into this.
lines.zh: 嗯，变成了现在这样。

lines.en: But this is the ideal place for a dish like ramen.
lines.zh: 但对拉面这种菜来说，这里是理想之地。

lines.en: It’s not meant to be fancy. It’s not meant to be {i}gourmet.{/i}
lines.zh: 它不该是精致的。它不该是「{i}美食{/i}」。

lines.en: It’s just food that warms the heart.
lines.zh: 它只是能温暖人心的食物。

lines.en: Or at least what’s left of it.
lines.zh: 至少是温暖那颗心剩下的部分。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen1
: Good evening. Welcome to Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 晚上好。欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。

lines.en: : Please take your time looking over the menu and let me know if you have any questions.
lines.zh: : 请慢慢看菜单，有什么问题随时告诉我。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen2
: Ah-
: You do realize it’s me, right? Your teacher?
lines.zh: : 你知道是我吧？你的老师？

lines.en: : You don’t have to give me the same customary greeting that you give everyone else.
lines.zh: : 你不必跟对其他客人一样，给我那套惯常的问候。

lines.en: : There is no customary greeting. Everyone else just sits down.
lines.zh: : 没有什么惯常的问候。别人都是直接坐下。

lines.en: : I have decided to greet you as today is a day to celebrate.
lines.zh: : 我决定问候你，因为今天是个值得庆祝的日子。

lines.en: : To celebrate {i}what{/i} exactly?
lines.zh: : 庆祝{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : A curse free life.
lines.zh: : 无咒的人生。

lines.en: : You’re still going on about the curse?
lines.zh: : 你还在纠结那个咒？

lines.en: : I am. The Emerald Guardian informed me that it was not a curse after all. Who knew?
lines.zh: : 是的。翡翠守护者告诉我那根本不是咒。谁知道呢？

lines.en: : I did. I literally told you.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我明明跟你说过。

lines.en: : I don't remember that.
lines.zh: : 我不记得了。

lines.en: : Well, it happened.
lines.zh: : 嗯，确实发生过。

lines.en: : I apologize. I often find myself having a hard time paying attention while you're talking.
lines.zh: : 我道歉。你说话的时候，我常常很难集中注意力。

lines.en: : But you are alive. And that is all that truly matters.
lines.zh: : 但你还活着。这才是真正重要的。

lines.en: : I'm offended by the first part of that statement, but applaud you for ending on an insightful note.
lines.zh: : 前半句让我很受伤，不过结尾那句有见地，值得表扬。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen3
: I am full of nothing but wisdom and noodles.
lines.zh: : 我体内除了智慧和面条，什么都没有。

lines.en: Tsuneyo passes me a menu after having just fulfilled her noodle-mention-quota for the night.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 把菜单递给我——她今晚的「面条提及配额」刚用完。

lines.en: I take a moment to look it over and realize that everything on the menu is insanely cheap.
lines.zh: 我花了一点时间看了看，发现菜单上所有东西都便宜得离谱。

lines.en: It didn’t occur to me the first time I came here since I...wound up paying for two people, but I’m surprised Tsuneyo’s family is even able to stay in business with prices like these.
lines.zh: 第一次来时我没注意到，因为我……最后付了两个人的钱，不过我很惊讶 Tsuneyo 家以这种价格居然还能维持经营。

lines.en: I feel like they haven't been updated in decades.
lines.zh: 我觉得这些价格大概几十年没更新过了。

lines.en: : Hey, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen2
: Ah-
: Why is everything so cheap here?
lines.zh: : 这里的东西为什么这么便宜？

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen1
: Cheap?
lines.zh: : 便宜？

lines.en: : Yeah. You’re charging next to nothing for virtually every dish on the menu.
lines.zh: : 对。菜单上几乎每道菜你都收得跟白送一样。

lines.en: : Oh. You mean {i}cheap.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦。你是说「{i}便宜{/i}」啊。

lines.en: : ...That’s exactly what I said?
lines.zh: : ……我不就是这么说的吗？

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen4
: I suppose it may have something to do with the people who live in this half of town.
lines.zh: : 我想，大概和住在这半边的人有关。

lines.en: : I’m sure you have noticed, but the old district is not in the best of shape.
lines.zh: : 你肯定注意到了，旧城区的状况不太好。

lines.en: : The most populous demographic in the area is the elderly. And next is the poor.
lines.zh: : 这一带人口最多的群体是老人。其次是穷人。

lines.en: : Everyone else lives much further away.
lines.zh: : 其他人都住得远得多。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen1
: All of the people stuck here are simply waiting to die.
lines.zh: : 所有困在这儿的人，不过是在等死。

lines.en: : That’s...dark.
lines.zh: : 这……太阴暗了。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen3
: Yes. I suppose it is.
lines.zh: : 是啊。大概吧。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen1
: Do you know what you’d like to order?
lines.zh: : 你想好点什么了吗？

lines.en: What kind of mood whiplash is this? Jumping straight from condemning the entire population here to taking my order?
lines.zh: 这情绪转变得也太突然了吧？刚把这儿的全体居民判了死刑，就直接跳到点单？

lines.en: I know Tsuneyo doesn't have much experience holding conversations, but...she at least has to learn how to transition between topics.
lines.zh: 我知道 Tsuneyo 没什么聊天的经验，可是……她至少该学会怎么在话题之间过渡。

lines.en: : Uhh...can you tell me what the “Red Dragon” is?
lines.zh: : 呃……你能告诉我「红龙」是什么吗？

lines.en: : It is the red version of the Green Dragon.
lines.zh: : 是绿龙的红色版本。

lines.en: : So it’s...spicier, I’m guessing?
lines.zh: : 所以是……更辣，我猜？

lines.en: : Yes. Just like in ancient times.
lines.zh: : 对。就像古时候一样。

lines.en: : The red dragons were much more dangerous than the green ones.
lines.zh: : 红龙比绿龙危险得多。

lines.en: : But dragons didn’t actually exist in ancient times. Those were just fairy tales.
lines.zh: : 可古时候根本没有龙。那些只是童话。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen5
: Did you...really not know that?
lines.zh: : 你……真的不知道吗？

lines.en: : This is a shocking revelation.
lines.zh: : 这真是个令人震惊的发现。

lines.en: : All this time, I have been explaining the difference between the dishes by mentioning the dragons of ancient times.
lines.zh: : 一直以来，我都是用「古时候的龙」来解释这两道菜的区别。

lines.en: : Why did no one stop me?
lines.zh: : 为什么没人阻止我？

lines.en: : Well, you deal with mostly old people, right? They probably thought it was cute that you still believed in them.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你接触的大多是老人，对吧？他们大概觉得你到现在还相信龙，挺可爱的。

lines.en: : Are old people actually evil?
lines.zh: : 老人其实是邪恶的吗？

lines.en: : A lot of the time, yeah.
lines.zh: : 很多时候，是的。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen6
: I must remain vigilant in the face of the elderly. They could attack at any moment.
lines.zh: : 面对老年人，我必须保持警惕。他们随时可能发动攻击。

lines.en: : It's fine. They'll die before the rest of us, so you likely won't have to remain vigilant for very long.
lines.zh: : 没关系。他们会比我们其他人先死，所以你要保持警惕的时间大概不会太长。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen1
: I look forward to that day with great anticipation. Praise be.
lines.zh: : 我怀着极大的期待盼望着那一天。赞美。

lines.en: : Praise be.
lines.zh: : 赞美。

lines.en: : Wait, what are we praising?
lines.zh: : 等等，我们在赞美什么？

lines.en: : Noodles, perhaps?
lines.zh: : 也许是面条？

lines.en: : Well...anyway, I guess I’ll have the Green Dragon since it's...less red than the Red Dragon.
lines.zh: : 嗯……总之，我要绿龙吧，因为它……比红龙没那么红。

lines.en: : I understand.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : One Green Dragon, coming up.
lines.zh: : 一份绿龙，马上来。

lines.en: : As a word of advice, dragons are not real. The dish is based on a fictional creature from fairy tales.
lines.zh: : 给你一句忠告：龙是不存在的。这道菜是以童话里的虚构生物命名的。

lines.en: : Yes, Tsuneyo. I am the one who taught you this.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Tsuneyo。这正是我教你的。

lines.en: : You are lying. This is information I have known all along.
lines.zh: : 你在撒谎。这是我早就知道的信息。

lines.en: : Now, please excuse me while I go craft a dish named after a fictional creature that did not actually exist in ancient times.
lines.zh: : 那么失陪了，我要去做一道以古时候并不真实存在的虚构生物命名的菜。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen0
Tsuneyo disappears behind the curtain leading to the kitchen and I can hear her beginning to search through some shelves or cabinets or something.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 消失在通往厨房的帘子后面，我听见她开始翻找某个架子或柜子什么的。

lines.en: I wonder why she’d need to go back there when it looks like all of the ingredients are right behind her?
lines.zh: 所有食材看起来就在她身后，我不明白她为什么还要去后面。

lines.en: Maybe the Green Dragon requires some sort of...{i}special{/i} ingredients they store in the back?
lines.zh: 也许绿龙需要某种……存在后厨的「{i}特殊{/i}」食材？

lines.en: Oh well. Not like it matters anyway. I’m just glad to be able to eat something.
lines.zh: 算了。反正也不重要。能吃点东西我就很高兴了。

lines.en: Coming to this part of town is always draining, both physically and mentally- and I'm barely able to stay awake as-is.
lines.zh: 来这一带总是让人身心俱疲——而我本来就已经快撑不住要睡着了。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen1
: I have returned.
lines.zh: : 我回来了。

lines.en: : Oh, good timing.
lines.zh: : 哦，来得正好。

lines.en: : This ain’t my first rodeo, bro.
lines.zh: : 这种场面我见多了，兄弟。

lines.en: : Still at it with the whole informal speech thing?
lines.zh: : 还在练这套口语化的说话方式？

lines.en: : Am I improving?
lines.zh: : 我有进步吗？

lines.en: : You're getting worse, actually. That was extremely unnatural.
lines.zh: : 其实你越来越糟了。那句非常不自然。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen6
: Ugh...
: It’s fine. I’m already teaching one girl how to improve her public speaking and, weirdly enough, you seem much more open to learning.
lines.zh: : 没事。我已经在教一个女孩怎么提升公开演讲了，而奇怪的是，你看起来更愿意学。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen7
: You offer additional classes?
lines.zh: : 你还开额外的课？

lines.en: : Well...not {i}exactly.{/i} I kind of just show up to her work every once in a while and...accidentally insult her until she improves.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也{i}不完全{/i}是。我大概只是偶尔去她工作的地方……不小心羞辱她，直到她进步。

lines.en: : Did you come here to insult me?
lines.zh: : 你是来羞辱我的吗？

lines.en: : On my home turf?
lines.zh: : 在我的地盘上？

lines.en: : Watch your step, bro.
lines.zh: : 小心点，兄弟。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, you can’t just keep adding bro to sentences to make them informal. That isn’t how it works.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你不能一直往句子里加「兄弟」来显得口语化。不是这么用的。

lines.en: : Are you sure? Because I have studied our Yakuza clientele and have heard them use that word many times before.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？因为我研究过我们的山口组客人，听过他们用好多次这个词。

lines.en: : Why in the world are the Yakuza coming to a ramen shop in the middle of the old district?
lines.zh: : 到底为什么山口组会跑到旧城区正中的一家拉面店来？

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen8
: Because I am a food magician.
lines.zh: : 因为我是食物魔法师。

lines.en: : My flavors are unparalleled in the world of ramen.
lines.zh: : 我的风味在拉面界无与伦比。

lines.en: : They also occasionally used the back room to do business before my father fell ill.
lines.zh: : 在我父亲生病之前，他们偶尔也会用后面的房间谈生意。

lines.en: : What kind of business were they doing back there exactly?...
lines.zh: : 他们到底在后面谈什么生意？……

lines.en: : Apparently, they work in real estate.
lines.zh: : 听说他们做房地产。

lines.en: : And all this time, I thought they were some sort of gang.
lines.zh: : 一直以来，我还以为他们是某种帮派。

lines.en: : If more people knew their true goal was to provide affordable housing, I believe less people would fear them.
lines.zh: : 如果有更多人知道他们真正的目标是提供平价住房，我相信怕他们的人会少一些。

lines.en: : You're not serious, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不是认真的吧？

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen9
: Huh?
: What did I do now?...
lines.zh: : 我又怎么了？……

lines.en: : Nothing, Tsuneyo. I can’t teach you two valuable life lessons in one day.
lines.zh: : 没什么，Tsuneyo。我一天之内不能教你两堂宝贵的人生课。

lines.en: : Why is talking to you so much harder than it is talking to anyone else?
lines.zh: : 为什么跟你说话比跟任何人说话都难？

lines.en: : Who knows? Even I don’t understand my actions sometimes.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。有时候连我自己都不理解自己的行为。

lines.en: : It’s like, I’ll just be walking around, minding my own business...and suddenly, I’m sitting in a ramen shop teaching some girl about dragons.
lines.zh: : 就像，我本来好好走着自己的路、管着自己的事……突然间，我就坐在一家拉面店里，给某个女孩讲龙的知识。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen1
: That sounds extremely similar to what happened here today.
lines.zh: : 这听起来跟今天这儿发生的事一模一样。

lines.en: : It {i}is{/i} what happened here today.
lines.zh: : 这{i}就是{/i}今天这儿发生的事。

lines.en: : Oh. Right. Of course.
lines.zh: : 哦。对。当然。

lines.en: : Perhaps it was hunger that landed you here? That would make sense, would it not?
lines.zh: : 也许你是被饥饿带到这儿来的？这说得通，不是吗？

lines.en: : It would, but I don't think that's something you need to verbally rationalize.
lines.zh: : 说得通，但我觉得这种事你不必说出口来合理化。

lines.en: : Would you prefer to eat in silence?
lines.zh: : 你更愿意安静地吃吗？

lines.en: : I don’t even have any food yet.
lines.zh: : 我连食物都还没有。

lines.en: : It’s cooking.
lines.zh: : 在做了。

lines.en: : The Green Dragon requires special preparation.
lines.zh: : 绿龙需要特殊的准备。

lines.en: : What kind of special preparation? I don't even know what I-
lines.zh: : 什么样的特殊准备？我甚至不知道我——

lines.en: : Snake venom.
lines.zh: : 蛇毒。

lines.en: Don’t tell me that’s what she was doing when she went into the kitchen?
lines.zh: 别告诉我她进厨房的时候就是在弄那个？

lines.en: : On second thought, I don’t know if I want the Green-
lines.zh: : 再想想，我不知道我还想不想要绿——

lines.en: : It was a joke.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Surprise.
lines.zh: : 惊喜吧。

lines.en: : You really need to work on your delivery.
lines.zh: : 你真该练练你的表达方式。

lines.en: : Everything you say comes out in the same tone, so I can never tell when you’re kidding or not.
lines.zh: : 你说的每句话都是同一个语调，所以我永远分不清你是不是在开玩笑。

lines.en: : Do you really think we would use snake venom in ramen?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我们会在拉面里放蛇毒？

lines.en: : That is absurd.
lines.zh: : 那太荒谬了。

lines.en: : It would never work.
lines.zh: : 根本行不通。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen10
: Unless...
lines.zh: : 除非……

lines.en: : Unless what? What are you thinking right now?
lines.zh: : 除非什么？你现在在想什么？

lines.en: : Tell me- how much do you cherish your life?
lines.zh: : 告诉我——你有多珍惜自己的生命？

lines.en: : Enough to not agree to whatever you want me to agree with.
lines.zh: : 珍惜到不会答应任何你想让我答应你的事。

lines.en: : That is a shame. I had an excellent idea for a new menu item.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。我有个新菜品的绝妙点子。

lines.en: : How is it excellent if you don’t even know it’s safe to consume?
lines.zh: : 你连它能不能安全食用都不知道，怎么就绝妙了？

lines.en: : With great risk comes great reward. Thomas Jefferson said that.
lines.zh: : 高风险带来高回报。托马斯·杰斐逊说的。

lines.en: : Thomas who?
lines.zh: : 托马斯谁？

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen11
: Is he a mythical creature as well?!
lines.zh: : 他也是神话生物吗？！

lines.en: : No, I just wanted to see how you'd react if I pretended he was.
lines.zh: : 不是，我只是想看看如果假装他是，你会有什么反应。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen12
: That’s a relief. I was beginning to think everything I was taught had been a lie.
lines.zh: : 那就好。我还以为我学到的一切都是谎言。

lines.en: : Life was much simpler before I had to begin using my knowledge in real life.
lines.zh: : 在我不得不开始把知识用到现实生活之前，人生简单多了。

lines.en: : Yeah. I can see how homeschooling might leave some people behind.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我能想象在家自学可能会让一些人落下功课。

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen1
: I will do my best to learn the right meanings to things in your class.
lines.zh: : 我会在你的课上尽力学会事物正确的含义。

lines.en: : Just...try and have fun. Knowledge comes second.
lines.zh: : 就……尽量开心点。知识是次要的。

lines.en: : I understand. I will do my best to prioritize having fun over improving myself as a person.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。我会尽力把开心排在自我提升之前。

lines.en: : There you go. Just don’t expect too much from me and I'm sure you'll have a decently fulfilling school life.
lines.zh: : 这就对了。只要别对我期望太高，我相信你的学校生活会过得挺充实。

lines.en: : My expectations could not be any lower.
lines.zh: : 我的期望不可能更低了。

lines.en: : Well, that's kind of insulting.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话有点伤人。

lines.en: : Another joke. Ha ha ha ha ha.
lines.zh: : 又一个笑话。哈哈哈。

lines.en: : The {i}real{/i} joke here is your sense of humor.
lines.zh: : 这里{i}真正{/i}的笑话是你的幽默感。

lines.en: : Wow. You’re even worse than I am.
lines.zh: : 哇。你比我还烂。

lines.en: : That was not my proudest moment just now.
lines.zh: : 刚才那可不是我最光彩的时刻。

lines.en: : You should be ashamed.
lines.zh: : 你该感到羞耻。

lines.en: : I am. You don't have to-
lines.zh: : 我很羞耻。你不必——

lines.en: : Get out of my restaurant, you bastard.
lines.zh: : 滚出我的店，你这混蛋。

lines.en: : That was a joke too, right?
lines.zh: : 那也是个玩笑，对吧？

lines.en: scene firsttsuneyoramen8
: I’ll be right back.
lines.zh: : 我马上回来。

lines.en: scene black
Tsuneyo disappears behind the curtain yet again and retrieves a large green bowl filled with assorted toppings.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 又一次消失在帘子后面，取来一只装满各色配料的大绿碗。

lines.en: She ladles the broth from behind her into it and places the dish in front of me.
lines.zh: 她把身后的汤舀进碗里，把菜摆到我面前。

lines.en: After combing through it with my chopsticks to confirm that there are no traces of snake parts or any other strange ingredients, I dig in.
lines.zh: 我用筷子翻检了一遍，确认没有蛇的部件或别的奇怪食材之后，才开动。

lines.en: It’s heavenly.
lines.zh: 简直是天堂。
